#SBATCH --job-name=run_scflow
#SBATCH --time=24:00:00
#SBATCH --nodes=1

#SBATCH --mem=20gb
#SBATCH --output=~/snRNAseq_analysis/log/scflow/run.out
#SBATCH --error=~/snRNAseq_analysis/log/scflow/run.err

# tmux new -s scflow

cd ~/snRNAseq_analysis/

. ~/.bashrc
conda activate nfcore
module load gcc/8.2.0
NXF_OPTS='-Xms1g -Xmx4g'
NXF_SINGULARITY_CACHEDIR='~/snRNAseq_analysis/singularity/'

nextflow run nf-core/scflow \
  -c config/scflow/oesophageal_10X.config \
  -r dev \
  -profile imperial \
  -resume \
  -w work/scflow/
"
}
